page.layout: One printed page: running head at top centre; text block above a framed ornament; a woodcut ornament in the centre of the lower area; faint show-through text in the right margin (not transcribed).

main_text.p: perque florentissimum conservet. Vale. Cantabrigiæ, è Collegio D. Ioannis Evangelistæ, Prid. Calend. Maias. 1588.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (heart-shaped floral design) in the centre of the page; no text. The right and left margins show only show-through and border rules, not transcribed. The first line is printed as "perque florentissimum conservet." in the scan; the letters "perq́ue" with a tilde over the q are copied as "perque". The signature line "Guilielmus Whitakerus." is italic in the original, and the first line of the text is set in a smaller size than the running head.
